input_units.initial_C: degree C; explicitly permitted initial lubricant measurement

missingness: Original missing targets retained; no target-based exclusions; same cohort as original; new covariates from measured empty-flow or strict past native-clock weather only.

terms: causal housing-minus-environment convolution; complementary weights sum to one

equations.reference: Two parallel stable states H_tau and S_tau use previous-sample exponential recurrence. yhat = H_fast + gamma_fast S_fast + gamma_slow S_slow + c(H_slow-H_fast), with H_tau(0)=TL0, S_tau(0)=0 and c in[0,1].

limitations: Five identification runs and eight source validation runs in one gearbox. Initial calibration and measured housing/friction signals are required; no unseen gearbox or sensorless temperature claim.
ALL original confirmation exposed; no fresh confirmation; diagnostics opened only after candidate/stopping freeze
All model families established; no demonstrated new physical law or deployed intervention benefit.
Different information contract:52 independent no-turbine calibration;59 strict past weather inputs. Legacy reference is lower-information comparator in these cases.
reproduction: run.py is input-only. Source targets are exposed; scientific review separate from numerical score.
